title: 第一卷 第17章 他逃她追他插翅就飞第一卷 第18章 妖女重伤老登救美
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
;;
小半天后。
李寒山蹲在一棵古树的枝桠上，将气息收敛到极致，如同一块长在树上的枯木。
不远处，两群妖兽正在混战，争夺一棵发光的果树。
李寒山没有急着动手。
两群妖兽的战斗很快有了，一群落下大量尸体后离去，另一群也没讨得了好，身上多多少少都带着伤，它们啃食其妖兽尸体，不多时，一个个便将肚子吃得圆鼓鼓的，懒洋洋地趴在地上，开始打盹。
就是现在。
飞剑化作流光，自树上激射而出。
一只，两只，三只......飞剑划出了死亡的痕迹，高速收割着妖兽的生命。
“嗷呜！”
剩余的妖兽终于察觉到了李寒山，咆哮着冲来，等待它们的是李寒山的火弹。
“轰轰轰~”
仅仅几分钟后，所有的妖兽便被杀了一空。
李寒山从树上跳下，收回飞剑后，便来到发光的果树前，将上面还未完全成熟的果实采摘一空。他没时间慢慢等它们成熟了。
然后，他踩着飞剑离开，找到了一个位于高处的山洞，拿出补气丹吃下，调息恢复起来。
小半时辰后，李寒山睁开眼，看向试炼令，发现上面的积分已然变成了一百五。
这是他大半天的收获。
照这样下去，只需六七天，便可凑够一千积分。
“希望这几天不要被花弄影找到。”
正想着，一道流光朝着他的方向快速掠来，待看清上面的人后，李寒山脸色骤变。

“靠，她怎么来了？”
到来的，正是花弄影。
真是说曹操，曹操到！
李寒山顾不得多想，祭出飞剑便朝远方逃去。
他御剑飞行的速度远不如花弄影，不多时，便被花弄影将距离拉近到了数十米。
“主人～”
身后传来花弄影娇媚入骨的声音：“你跑什么呀？奴家好不容易才找到你呢～”
李寒山咬紧牙关，拼命催动灵力，将速度提到极致。
可炼气八层与炼气大圆满的差距摆在那里，花弄影的身影越来越近，那抹红衣在暮色中格外刺眼。
“逃不掉了！”
李寒山索性收了飞剑，落到了地上。
片刻后，花弄影轻飘飘地落在他前方数米处，烟杆横衔在唇间，笑盈盈地看着他：“主人，你逃不掉的。”
李寒山深吸一口气，冷冷道：“你终于不装了？”
花弄影歪了歪脑袋，露出天真无邪的表情：“主人说什么呀？人家只是担心你呢～”
她款款走来，腰肢轻摆，红衣似火：“主人不知道，奴家找了你多久。这秘境好大，奴家腿都走酸了呢～”
李寒山没有后退，冷声问：“你是怎么找到我的？”

Half a day later.
Li Hanshan squatted on the branches of an ancient tree, concentrating his breath to the extreme, like a piece of dead wood growing on the tree.
Not far away, two groups of monsters were fighting for a glowing fruit tree.
Li Hanshan was not in a hurry to take action.
The battle between the two groups of monsters soon began. One group left after leaving a large number of corpses, while the other group did not get any better. They were more or less injured. They gnawed on the corpses of their monsters. After a while, each of them ate their stomachs until they were bulging. They lay lazily on the ground and began to take a nap.
That's it now.
The flying sword turned into a stream of light and shot out from the tree.
One, two, three... the flying swords drew traces of death, harvesting the lives of the monster beasts at high speed.
"Ouch!"
The remaining monsters finally noticed Li Hanshan and rushed towards him with roars. What awaited them was Li Hanshan's fire bullets.
"Boom boom boom~"
In just a few minutes, all the monsters were killed.
Li Hanshan jumped down from the tree, retracted his flying sword, then came to the glowing fruit tree and picked all the unripe fruits on it. He didn't have time to wait for them to mature.
Then, he stepped on the flying sword and left, found a cave at a high place, took out the qi-boosting pill and ate it, adjusting his breath and recovering.
Half an hour later, Li Hanshan opened his eyes, looked at the trial order, and found that the points on it had become one hundred and fifty.
This was his harvest for most of the day.
If this continues, it will only take six or seven days to collect one thousand points.
"I hope I won't be found by Hua Nongying in the next few days."
Just as he was thinking about it, a stream of light quickly swept towards him. After seeing the person above clearly, Li Hanshan's expression suddenly changed.
"Damn, why is she here?"
It was Hua Nongying who arrived.
Really talking about Cao Cao, Cao Cao is here!
Li Hanshan didn't think much, took out his flying sword and ran away into the distance.
The flying speed of his sword was far inferior to that of Hua Nongying. After a short time, Hua Nongying narrowed the distance to dozens of meters.
"Master~"
Hua Nongying's charming voice came from behind: "Why are you running? It took a lot of effort for the slave family to find you~"
Li Hanshan gritted his teeth, desperately activated his spiritual power, and raised his speed to the extreme.
But the gap between the eighth level of Qi Refining and the Great Perfection of Qi Refining was there. Hua Nongying's figure was getting closer and closer, and the red dress was particularly dazzling in the dusk.
"Can't escape!"
Li Hanshan simply put away the flying sword and fell to the ground.
After a moment, Hua Nongying landed lightly a few meters in front of him, holding the cigarette rod between her lips, looking at him with a smile: "Master, you can't escape."
Li Hanshan took a deep breath and said coldly: "You finally stop pretending?"
Hua Nongying tilted her head and showed an innocent expression: "What did the master say? I'm just worried about you~"
She walked forward gracefully, her waist swaying lightly, and her red dress was like fire: "Master doesn't know how long I have been looking for you. This secret realm is so big, my legs are sore from walking~"
Li Hanshan did not retreat and asked coldly: "How did you find me?"
